reason: The report quantifies electrolyzers only through Table 8 ('Average statistics based on manufacturers' data') and Table 9 ('Specifications of electrolyzer units as modeled here'), both specification tables, and through the hydrogen-production inventories (Table 10 PEM, Table 13 AEC, Table 12 autonomous plant) which are per kg of hydrogen.
